review_notes: Principal baseline family: Table 4’s triple-differences tests in §4.2, using the three measures the authors identify as inclusive-culture proxies in the introduction: Diversity, Promotion, and board diversity (physical pp. 4, 25–27). Retain the fully controlled Table 4 Panel A column 2 (Diversity), Panel A column 3 (Promotion), and Panel B column 1 (High board diversity). These are distinct operational moderators, not stepwise additions to one RHS.

Scope decision: exclude Table 4 Panel A column 1 Overall ESG as the broad generic-ESG contrast to the stated inclusive-culture measures (physical pp. 4, 28); exclude Panel B columns 2–3 because the authors introduce High Female and High Minority as separate follow-up decompositions after the composite High board diversity result (physical p. 29). Table 3 addresses product/customer-quality CSR; Table 5 tests predetermined cultural roots; Table 6 returns to longer pre-pandemic board-change events. These are distinct extensions rather than supporting construction regressions for the retained Table 4 baseline family (physical pp. 22–25, 30–33).

Underlying regression estimator is not named in the selected section or Table 4; it is left unknown rather than inferred from the linear table layout. The specification uses triple interactions, fixed effects, and clustered robust standard errors.
results_review_notes: The baseline family includes three distinct full-control moderation specifications: Diversity, Promotion, and High board diversity. Overall ESG is the paper’s broad-ESG comparison to the inclusive-culture constructs; High Female and High Minority are follow-up decompositions of composite board diversity, so their Table 4 columns are outside this selected family.

The paper reports exact p-values for two sums of coefficients in the discussion (Promotion: p=0.53; High board diversity: p=0.26). The contrast labels and reported p-values are retained as model-level auxiliary results; test type, reference distribution, degrees of freedom, and sidedness are not specified and remain unknown.
